description: October 17, 2024GODFREY, IL - State Representative Amy Elik has received the endorsement from several groups who represent first responders. The Illinois Fraternal Order of Police, Associated Fire Fighters of Illinois, Sheriffs of Illinois PAC, and Chicago Fire Fighters Union Local 2 have come together to enthusiastically support Elik.These groups represent thousands of first responders across Illinois, and their endorsements recognize Elik’s dedication to the well being of police, firefighters,
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Amy Elik
title: Rep. Amy Elik Endorsed by First Responders
